from flask import Flask
from flask_mail import Mail, Message

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config.update(
    MAIL_SERVER='{{smtp_host}}',
    MAIL_PORT={{smtp_port}},
    MAIL_USE_TLS=True,
    MAIL_USERNAME=__import__('os').environ.get('SMTP_USER'),
    MAIL_PASSWORD=__import__('os').environ.get('SMTP_PASS'),
    MAIL_DEFAULT_SENDER='{{from_address}}'
)
mail = Mail(app)

def send(to, subject, body):
    with app.app_context():
        mail.send(Message(subject=subject, recipients=[to], body=body))
